_comment: Global preferences applied to every project. Edit this file to set your defaults.
author: Kyle

branding.footer_text: Questions? Reach out in the team channel.

style_preferences: Use bold for UI element names (buttons, tabs, field labels)
Use em for values the user types or selects
Step text should be imperative: 'Click X' not 'You should click X'
Warn callouts for things that can cause mistakes; tip callouts for shortcuts or alternatives
Keep step count under 10 per part — split into new parts if longer
